next.reason: The CHANGED answers missed the restatement: §2023:9.1.13.1 says verbatim 'Logic error. The input-output statement was unsuccessfully executed as a result of an improper sequence of input-output operations that were performed on the file or as a result of violating a limit defined by the user.' That prose has no catalog rule id; the catalog rules of the class are the 4x values of 9.1.13.7. Status 45 (§2023:9.1.13.7 GR5, 'Record identification failure') is a new value in the class, a change to the status-value rule (1985 VIII.1.3.4 L2.5), not to this definition.
